candidate.original_question: What procedure or remedy is described in the clause beginning “] (d) rules as to the entertainment of…”?
candidate.proposed_question: What may rules under Article 145(1)(d) provide for?
candidate.proposed_answer: Rules may provide for the entertainment of appeals under Article 134(1)(c).
candidate.source_text_finding: Article 145(1)(d) concerns rules for entertainment of appeals under sub-clause (c) of Article 134(1).
candidate.quality_or_scope_flags: Proposed answer/reference accurately restate the listed subject, using Article 134(1)(c) notation. The cited PDF page contains the provision's amendment-note context; the text was checked on the supplied version only.
